About Our Internship Program
Zoox's internship program offers hands-on experience with cutting-edge technology, mentorship from some of the industry's brightest minds, and the opportunity to make meaningful contributions to real projects. We seek interns who demonstrate strong academic performance, engagement beyond the classroom, intellectual curiosity, and a genuine interest in Zoox's mission.

Job Description
Autonomy Software builds the software that lets the Zoox robotaxi perceive its surroundings, predict what others will do, and plan and control the vehicle with no one behind the wheel. Interns join one of the teams below, work with a mentor on an open research or engineering question, and see a direct path from their work to the system that runs on Zoox vehicles and in simulation.

Interns in this pipeline may be considered for opportunities across a range of teams, including:

- Autonomy Behaviors: Owns the decision-making, planning & control modules, which decide how the vehicle drives. Projects include machine-learned planning, long-horizon reasoning, configurable driving styles, freeway driving and new vehicle platform bring-up.

- Perception: Gives the vehicle an understanding of its surroundings using camera, lidar, radar and audio. Projects include object detection and tracking, multimodal foundation models, scene understanding, occupancy and 3D mapping.

- Guidance & Routing: Works on route-level planning and offline mapping, including the mission planner, map data delivery and road network tools.

- Collision Avoidance System: Runs an independent safety layer with its own perception and planning. This team also works on the evaluation and data tooling for verification.

In this Role, You Will...

- Work on interesting research or advanced engineering problems that could have the potential to revolutionize the existing Autonomy Software stack.

- Design, build and evaluate state-of-the-art algorithms or machine learning models for a real autonomous driving system.

- Train and test models on large-scale driving and simulation data, and analyze failure modes to measure improvements.

- Write production-quality C++ and Python that goes through code review.

- Present your results to your team and at the end-of-summer project showcase, and contribute to publishable research where the project allows.

Requirements

- Currently working towards a M.S. or Ph.D. in computer science, robotics, electrical engineering, or a related engineering program

- Expected to graduate between Fall 2027 and Summer 2028, and enrolled at an accredited college or university throughout the internship

- Able to commit to a full-time, 12-week internship beginning in May/June 2027

- Ability to relocate to the Bay Area, California, for the duration of the internship

- Interns at Zoox may not use any proprietary information they are working on as part of their thesis, any published work with their university, or to be distributed to anyone outside of Zoox

Qualifications

- Currently working towards a M.S. or Ph.D. in computer science, robotics, electrical engineering, or a related engineering program

- Strong programming skills in C++ and/or Python

- Solid computer science fundamentals, including data structures and algorithms

- Experience with PyTorch, Jax, Tensorflow, Numpy

- Experience in at least one of machine learning, computer vision, motion planning, controls, prediction or mapping

- Clear communication of technical results

Bonus Qualifications

- Publications in top ML or robotics conferences (e.g. NeurIPS, CVPR, ICRA)

- Experience with autonomous driving or learned robotic planning

- Experience with large-scale, multi-node training workloads

Compensation

The monthly salary range for this position is $6,500 to $10,500. Compensation will vary based on geographic location and level of education. Additional benefits may include medical insurance and a relocation stipend.

About Zoox

Zoox is developing the first ground-up, fully autonomous vehicle fleet and the supporting ecosystem required to bring this technology to market. Sitting at the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and design, Zoox aims to provide the next generation of mobility-as-a-service in urban environments. We’re looking for top talent that shares our passion and wants to be part of a fast-moving and highly execution-oriented team.

Follow us on LinkedIn

Accommodations

If you need an accommodation to participate in the application or interview process please reach out to accommodations@zoox.com or your assigned recruiter.

You do not need to match every listed expectation to apply for this position. Here at Zoox, we know that diverse perspectives foster the innovation we need to be successful, and we are committed to building a team that encompasses a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and skills.

Lila Sciences is building scientific superintelligence by pairing large-scale automated experimentation with frontier machine learning. Within Lila, the Life Science AI (LSAI) function researches automated reasoning on biological data, combining state-of-the-art ML with breakthrough biology.

You'll own a defined research project with mentorship from ML scientists, and you'll work closely with experimental scientists to connect your models to real biological data.

Are you ready to explore the world of aerospace and defense? Do you want to learn from and collaborate with some of the greatest minds in the industry? At RTX, our internships, co-ops and full-time careers provide an exceptional foundation to work on complex problems, advance your skills and create a safer, more connected world. Discover opportunities to make a difference at RTX.

What You Will Do

Collins Aerospace is a leader in technologically advanced, intelligent solutions that help redefine the aerospace and defense industry. With a comprehensive portfolio and deep technical expertise, we help customers meet the demands of the global market. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

Applied Signal Technology (AST) is seeking engineers who strive for excellence and have a passion to be part of a team that strengthens our nation and improves the security of our world. AST provides trusted strategic and tactical SIGINT solutions that secure the interests of the U.S. and its partners. AST’s work in areas such as high-capacity broadband communications, signal processing and analysis, tactical SIGINT, and wireless communications continually challenges our extraordinary engineers to resolve problems and make the world a safer place. AST’s work environment is dynamic, highly collaborative and provides engineers the freedom to strengthen and expand their skills, explore new and creative ideas, and work closely with our nation’s finest service members all while embracing integrity and work-life balance.

This position will be staffed in Annapolis Junction, MD.

Our team has a need for a Software Engineer who is inspired by a job that challenges them to be proactive, make decisions, and generate ideas that drive product development to greater heights. Responsibilities span the full lifecycle of product development, from architecture and design, through integration, test, and field support. You will contribute to the build, test, and delivery of a set of software applications to be deployed to advanced systems that process modern communications for the U.S. Government. The successful candidate will have a solid understanding of concepts related to standard programming practices, software architecture, and networking.

- Work on complex technical problems while participating on collaborative, cross-disciplined integrated product teams
- Work will be performed with guidance of a product lead and team members who will assist in establishing an approach, perform code review and support in testing

What You Will Learn

- How to collaborate productively and professionally in a team-based development environment using disciplined engineering processes
- How to develop code with the larger end product and customers in mind
- Exposure to large code bases and toolsets like Jira, Confluence, Git, and Docker

Qualifications You Must Have

- Must be pursuing a Bachelor's or advanced degree in Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or related Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM) major and actively enrolled through the completion of the internship/co-op session.
- Experience developing in C++ in a Linux environment
- Experience with one or more scripting languages, Python, Linux script, Bash

Experience may be obtained through on-the-job experience, research, coursework, or projects.

Qualifications We Prefer

- Experience with Object Oriented Design and Development
- Software development experience (i.e. internship, co-op, or other work or academic project experience)
- Experience working both in a team environment and individually
- Experience Rust
- Experience with Qt
- Experience with User Interface development
- Experience with Angular web GUI development
- Experience with Multithreading
- Embedded SW Design Experience
- Experience in integrating software with hardware
- Experience with Configuration Management tools, such as git
- Experience maintaining and using build processes (makefiles, CMake)
- Experience and/or knowledge of network protocols, such as TCP/IP
- Experience with or basic understanding of telecommunications systems concepts and/or signal processing
- Experience with Network Protocols
- Experience with or basic understanding of International Telecommunication Union (ITU) Standards
